ufo-0.title: Roswell incident
ufo-0.summary: Debris recovered from a ranch near Roswell was announced by the Army Air Field as a "flying disc", then re-described as a weather balloon. In 1994-95 the USAF reported it was most likely a Project Mogul balloon train.
evidence: Physical debris recovered by Roswell Army Air Field (1947).
GAO 1995 review; USAF reports 1994 and 1997 ("The Roswell Report").
ufo-0.license: Summary written for Anomaly Atlas from the linked sources; Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0.

breakdown: Identified / explained (conventional cause): USAF 1994 report: Project Mogul balloon

rumors.text: A crashed alien spacecraft and alien bodies were recovered and hidden by the military.
"Alien autopsy" film (1995) shows a body from the crash.
The debris was a classified Project Mogul balloon, not a weather balloon as first stated.

ufo-1.title: Phoenix Lights
ufo-1.summary: Thousands of people across Arizona reported a V-shaped formation of lights and a later series of stationary lights. The later lights were attributed to flares dropped by A-10 aircraft from Operation Snowbird; the earlier formation remains debated.
evidence: Then-Governor Fife Symington later said he saw the craft.
ufo-1.license: Summary written for Anomaly Atlas from the linked sources; Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0.

breakdown: Partly explained / leading theory accepted by many researchers: Later lights attributed to military flares

rumors.text: A mile-wide V-shaped craft silently flew over the state.
The lights were LUU-2B illumination flares dropped by Maryland Air National Guard A-10s.
Governor Symington mocked the event at a press conference using a costumed aide, then a decade later said he personally saw something unexplained.

ufo-2.title: Rendlesham Forest incident
ufo-2.summary: USAF personnel from RAF Woodbridge reported lights and a craft in the forest over several nights. Deputy base commander Lt Col Charles Halt recorded a memo and an audio tape. Skeptics point to the Orford Ness lighthouse and a fireball.
evidence: "Halt memo" released by UK Ministry of Defence.
Depressions and radiation readings reported at landing site.

breakdown: Explanation proposed but disputed: Lighthouse / fireball explanation

rumors.text: A landed craft bore hieroglyph-like symbols that an airman touched and later recalled as binary code.
The lights were the Orford Ness lighthouse seen through the trees.
